name: vanilla-js-product-crud
description: Vanilla JavaScript CRUD product management system with search, calculation, and local data persistence.

paragraphs: A responsive single-page web application implementing a complete Product Management System (CRUD) using pure Vanilla JavaScript. Features client-side state management, tax/discount calculation, bulk creation, search filtering, and persistent browser storage.
features: Automated Price Aggregation: Dynamically computes total product cost combining base price, taxes, advertising costs, and discounts in real-time with visual color feedback.
Create: Add single products or batch generate up to 100 inventory units via count multiplier.
Update: Pre-fills form fields into edit mode, updating existing records in-place without page reload.
Delete: Supports single record deletion or clearing the entire database (Delete All).
